ACTION 08 OF 32 · PHASE 02

Make a real-world feasibility call

Test willingness to act and pay, not just positive reactions.

WHEN TO DO THISBefore committing to a full website/app, lease or expensive equipment.ESTIMATED WORK TIME1–2 weeks
↗
Your one job

Test willingness to act and pay, not just positive reactions.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Choose one clear offer and a specific first customer group.

  2. 02

    Interview likely buyers and record their current behavior and objections.

  3. 03

    Use a landing page, direct outreach, waitlist or small measured ad experiment where appropriate.

  4. 04

    Set a cost cap and track qualified inquiries, deposits only for fulfillable offers, conversions and reasons people say no.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Design the smallest honest market validation experiment for [OFFER] with [CUSTOMER] in [LOCATION]. Give me the audience, one test message, execution steps, spending/time cap, what counts as a qualified lead, success and failure decision thresholds, and a simple results table. Do not assume ad clicks mean customers. Do not accept payment if delivery is not ready.
03

Finish with this

A short experiment report: sample, actual outcomes, constraints and TEST / BUILD / PARK / STOP decision.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • The test has a defined decision rule
  • Real customer action is recorded
  • The decision reflects evidence and unit economics
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Using likes or compliments as proof of market fit.

READY TO MOVE ON?

At least three relevant alternatives are documented; there's a plausible customer gap and a way to test it.
